info.title: V-Scheduler Controller API
info.description: The unified V-Scheduler VOS app contains the V-Router model gateway and this controller. This API controls task execution and resource reservations on managed VOS or remote nodes; it does not proxy model payloads. Cloud provider models bypass local scheduling through V-Router. Synchronous local models use V-Router permits; asynchronous application work uses tasks. VOS package versions are separate from this v1 controller contract. Authenticated app-scoped access; operator-approved dynamic enrollment, node budgets, executor approval and scoped service credentials; one active execution lane per node; no HA or multi-node gang execution.

post.summary: Calibrate or directly pass a built-in model budget
post.description: Administrator-only. mode=calibrated (default) replaces the automatic estimate with approved resources and optional runtime limits; limits must contain exactly the six documented keys and default to max_tokens 4096, num_ctx 8192, num_thread 4, num_gpu 999, num_batch 512 and num_predict 4096. mode=direct forbids resources and limits, removes the executor and limits from the binding, and forwards verified calls without a permit, queue or resource admission.

x-description.zh-CN: 仅管理员。calibrated（默认）用批准的资源和可选运行上限替代自动估算；limits 必须恰好包含六个键，省略时使用 4096/8192/4/999/512/4096 默认值。direct 不得携带 resources 或 limits，会移除绑定中的执行器和运行上限，请求不再申请许可、排队或做资源准入。
x-description.en: Administrator-only. mode=calibrated (default) replaces the automatic estimate with approved resources and optional runtime limits; limits must contain exactly the six documented keys and default to max_tokens 4096, num_ctx 8192, num_thread 4, num_gpu 999, num_batch 512 and num_predict 4096. mode=direct forbids resources and limits, removes the executor and limits from the binding, and forwards verified calls without a permit, queue or resource admission.

delete.description: Application service identity only; refuses while executions, tasks or unconfirmed stop commands remain. Does not revoke approved resource budgets.

x-description.zh-CN: 应用心跳及停止命令 返回 executions 和 complete_execution_snapshot；最多 256 项，非完整快照不可用于清理回执，不返回执行令牌。
x-description.en: Follow heartbeat_after_seconds. Pending stop commands are redelivered until matched native execution proof is confirmed. App heartbeats cannot forge node telemetry. Returns outstanding executions (permit_id, executor_id, execution_id, state) and complete_execution_snapshot. At most 256 entries; false completeness forbids journal pruning. No execution tokens are returned.

post.description: Internal owned-Ollama protocol only. Revalidate identity, executor, node, model and execution proof; require native active_slots=0 and fresh bounded residency evidence. Rotate proof and retain materialized memory while returning idle CPU/GPU slots. Promotion through reuse-resident restores the complete approved budget atomically; third-party applications cannot use this endpoint.

x-description.zh-CN: 网关创建 HTTP、SSE、WebSocket 或异步模型工作前申请资源。executor_id 与 upstream_url 必须匹配已批准执行器及真实节点；model_id 用于审计，预算来自固定模板。节点离线、遥测过期、排空、系统余量或预约不足时拒绝，不得失败后直跑。异步任务确认不是停止证据。云端供应商不调用此接口。
x-description.en: Admit HTTP, SSE, WebSocket or asynchronous model creation before computation. executor_id and upstream_url must match an approved executor on the actual node; model_id is recorded for audit. Fixed budgets, fresh telemetry and system headroom gate admission. An async receipt is not stop evidence. Cloud providers do not call this API.
x-description.zh-TW: 網關建立 HTTP、SSE、WebSocket 或非同步模型工作前申請資源。executor_id 與 upstream_url 須匹配已核准執行器及實際節點；model_id 用於稽核，預算來自固定範本。節點離線、遙測過期、排空、系統餘量或預約不足時拒絕。非同步任務確認不是停止證據。雲端供應商不呼叫此介面。

parameters.name: X-VScheduler-Admin-Authorization
parameters.description: Only for force_admission: Bearer VOS administrator token; never persist it in a task or replay it after restart.

post.description: Same scoped identity, Idempotency-Key and administrator proof as POST /permits. Waiters reserve no resources. The request contains admission metadata only; never inference payloads. Waiting is bounded to 0..300 seconds; 0 attempts immediate admission. A timeout returns 429 QUEUE_TIMEOUT. No inference is replayed.

x-description.zh-CN: 先取得已批准预算，再调用注册应用的启动 API；幂等重试不重放启动。结果未知保留预约并请求停止。
x-description.en: Reserve the approved budget before the registered start API. Idempotent retries never replay start; unknown outcomes retain reservations and request stop.

post.description: Reserve the approved resource budget before one idempotent start callback. Unknown outcomes request a stop and retain the reservation. A successful HTTP callback alone does not prove execution or stop.

enrollmentBearer.description: Administrator-issued, node-bound, expiring single-use invitation. It can only request pending worker registration.

progress.description: Latest progress snapshot. percent, if present, is a fraction from 0 to 1; stage and message are optional strings.

stage.description: Optional execution stage, merged into progress.stage.

message.description: Optional human-readable update, merged into progress.message.

execution_token.description: Optional private random capability for backend verification; never return it to a browser or log it.

p95_ms.description: Null until at least 20 valid samples are available.

failure_rate.description: Failed / (succeeded + failed) stopped attempts; cancellations excluded. Null without outcomes.

released_at.description: First confirmed stop or handoff; old released records without a recorded timestamp remain null.

placements.description: Additional compute nodes for model.infer only; exclude the primary node and duplicates. Each participant requires positive CPU/RAM and an approved fixed budget. All participants are reserved atomically. Not supported for async task execution or delegated permits.

progress.description: The saved progress snapshot; older events may have an empty object.

ModelBudgetLimits.description: Complete approved runtime limits for a calibrated built-in Ollama model. If omitted, all six defaults are applied.

placements.description: Additional compute nodes for model.infer only; exclude the primary node and duplicates. Each participant requires positive CPU/RAM and an approved fixed budget. All participants are reserved atomically. Not supported for async task execution or delegated permits.

execution_id.description: Exact claimed native execution ID; null only when the permit was never claimed. Confirmation locks the permit before checking.

Scheduling.description: Opt-in cooperative scheduling. Async restart requires an approved idempotent executor; synchronous requests are never replayed. force_admission requires a separately verified administrator and retains hard resource budgets and a 1 GiB host floor.

IntegrationControl.description: Optional application HTTP controls on an administrator-approved executor origin. Stop-only is supported; start requires an application-owned executor.

app_id.description: Administrator may target a registered application. Other identities can only use their own app.

input.description: Application-defined bounded input, at most 256 KiB.

idempotency_key.description: Alternatively use Idempotency-Key. Conflicting values are rejected.
